source_backbone: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew POWO/WCVP 2026; primary nomenclatural author-qualified records and Flora Novae Angliae
synonym_and_rank_caution: Poa pectinacea Geyer ex Steud. (1854, pro syn.) maps to E. spectabilis, but Poa pectinacea Michx. (1803) maps to E. pectinacea. Eragrostis pectinacea var. spectabilis maps to E. spectabilis, not the whole E. pectinacea species.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; no county/native fields changed
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — taxonomy-only; individual observations not voucher-confirmed
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no individual hybrid or cultivar ancestry determined
install_decision: Retain existing E. spectabilis canonical card. E. pectinacea related accepted species checked for boundary only; no installation, gallery, genus, county, or Pages changes.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis spectabilis (Pursh) Steud. (1840)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted Poaceae species, authority (Pursh) Steud.; no canonical edit
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts E. spectabilis at species rank.

decisions.subject: Poa spectabilis Pursh (1813)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as homotypic basionym of E. spectabilis
decisions.detail: Author-qualified original epithet spectabilis, not a separate Poa card.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis pectinacea var. spectabilis (Pursh) A.Gray (1856)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historic variety to accepted E. spectabilis, not to E. pectinacea
decisions.detail: POWO explicitly places the infraspecific combination among homotypic synonyms of E. spectabilis.

decisions.subject: Megastachya spectabilis (Pursh) Roem. & Schult. (1817)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historic genus transfer to E. spectabilis

decisions.subject: Poa hirsuta var. spectabilis (Pursh) Torr. (1823)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to E. spectabilis

decisions.subject: Poa amabilis Walter (1788)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as illegitimate later homonym in E. spectabilis synonym history; never install separately
decisions.detail: POWO explicitly flags nom. illeg. homonym. post.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis geyeri Steud. (1854)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical heterotypic synonym to E. spectabilis

decisions.subject: Eragrostis velutina Schrad. (1838)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical heterotypic synonym to E. spectabilis

decisions.subject: Eragrostis spectabilis var. sparsihirsuta Farw. (1927)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to E. spectabilis species rank; retain original label provenance
decisions.detail: POWO heterotypic synonym, not an independently accepted variety.

decisions.subject: Poa pectinacea Geyer ex Steud. (1854), pro syn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map author-qualified name published in synonymy to E. spectabilis; preserve pro syn. status
decisions.detail: Distinct author and publication from Poa pectinacea Michx. (1803); do not promote pro syn. name to independently accepted taxon.

decisions.subject: Eragrostis pectinacea (Michx.) Nees (1841)
decisions.proposed_decision: Keep separately accepted species from E. spectabilis
decisions.detail: POWO accepts both species; historical variety spectabilis does not collapse entire E. pectinacea species.

decisions.subject: Poa pectinacea Michx. (1803)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map author-qualified basionym to accepted E. pectinacea, NOT E. spectabilis
decisions.detail: POWO homotypic synonym of E. pectinacea.

decisions.subject: Poa villosa Beyr. ex Schrad. (1838), pro syn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as POWO heterotypic synonym designation of E. spectabilis with pro syn. caveat
decisions.detail: Not evidence of independently accepted Poa species.

decisions.subject: Erochloe spectabilis Raf. ex B.D.Jacks. (1893), pro syn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as POWO synonym designation of E. spectabilis with pro syn. caveat

decisions.subject: Resolve an authorless 'Poa pectinacea' label automatically to one species
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic mapping without authorship, publication and specimen concept
decisions.detail: Geyer ex Steud. points to E. spectabilis in POWO; Michx. points to E. pectinacea.

decisions.subject: Merge accepted E. pectinacea into E. spectabilis based on var. spectabilis
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject species-level merger or duplicate canonical alias
decisions.detail: Variety combination belongs to E. spectabilis, but E. pectinacea remains accepted separately.

decisions.subject: Taxon identity of individual Eragrostis spectabilis source observations or gallery photos
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve source identifications without independently certifying image/specimen identity
decisions.detail: Taxonomy-only review did not inspect pixels, vouchers, mature spikelets or underground parts.

decisions.subject: Hybrid or cultivated ancestry of individual purple lovegrass plants
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not infer hybrid ancestry, introgression, or cultivar identity
decisions.detail: No voucher/genetic or breeding evidence reviewed; no named hybrid established for these individual plants.

decisions.subject: Historical records containing only 'Poa pectinacea' with no author or voucher
decisions.proposed_decision: Leave exact historical taxon concept unresolved pending publication, author, original specimen, or context
decisions.detail: The same abbreviated string appears under different author-qualified POWO destinations.
